title: Restaurant Operations Analyst
description:
Job Summary

Leland Eating and Drinking House is seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Restaurant Operations Analyst to evaluate operational performance, review business data, and identify opportunities to improve restaurant efficiency and service quality. The successful candidate will analyze sales trends, labor costs, inventory usage, customer feedback, and daily operating reports to help management make informed business decisions.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, an understanding of restaurant operations, and the ability to translate data into practical recommendations. This position works closely with restaurant management, kitchen personnel, and service teams to support operational improvements and consistent customer experiences.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly restaurant performance data, including sales, transaction volumes, and service activity.
* Prepare operational reports, dashboards, and summaries for management review.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to revenue, labor utilization, inventory, customer satisfaction, and service efficiency.
* Review sales trends and identify patterns that may affect restaurant performance.
* Analyze food costs, inventory consumption, waste, and purchasing records to identify potential savings.
* Evaluate staffing levels, scheduling patterns, and labor costs against business needs.
* Review customer feedback and service reports to identify recurring concerns and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with kitchen and front-of-house teams to understand operational challenges and recommend practical solutions.
* Assess restaurant workflows and identify opportunities to improve productivity and coordination.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and operational planning by preparing relevant data and analysis.
* Verify the accuracy and consistency of information obtained from point-of-sale systems, inventory records, and other business sources.
* Track the results of operational changes and report on their effectiveness.
* Assist management in establishing measurable performance targets and monitoring progress.
* Maintain organized analytical documentation and protect confidential business information.
* Perform additional analytical and administrative duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in restaurant operations, business analysis, hospitality, or data reporting is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or similar spreadsheet applications.
* Ability to interpret numerical information and communicate findings clearly.
* Familiarity with sales reports, inventory records, labor data, and operational performance metrics.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet reporting deadlines.
* Professional judgment when handling confidential financial and operational information.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with management and restaurant staff.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with restaurant point-of-sale (POS) systems and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with business intelligence platforms or data visualization software.
* Understanding of food cost percentages, labor cost ratios, inventory turnover, and sales forecasting.
* Knowledge of restaurant workflow optimization and service quality measurement.
* Ability to identify trends, explain variances, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Experience preparing dashboards, performance summaries, or management presentations.
* Strong organizational skills and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Work Environment

The Restaurant Operations Analyst works in a restaurant business environment, collaborating with management and operational teams. The position primarily involves reviewing data, preparing reports, evaluating performance, and communicating recommendations. Occasional observation of restaurant service, inventory processes, or kitchen workflows may be necessary to understand operational conditions and validate findings.

Benefits

Depending on company policy, employment status, and eligibility, benefits may include:

* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Opportunities for professional development in restaurant analytics and business operations.
* Training in reporting systems and operational performance measurement.
* Potential advancement into Senior Operations Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or Restaurant Operations Manager positions.
* A collaborative environment with opportunities to contribute to business improvements.
* Paid time off or other employment benefits where offered by the employer.

About the Company

Leland Eating and Drinking House is the company associated with this opportunity. The Restaurant Operations Analyst supports management by reviewing business performance, identifying operational trends, and helping improve the efficiency of restaurant activities. This role contributes to informed decision-making by connecting operational data with practical recommendations for service, staffing, inventory, and cost management.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated résumé highlighting relevant experience in data analysis, business reporting, restaurant operations, or hospitality management. Applicants should emphasize their analytical abilities, spreadsheet skills, attention to detail, and capacity to communicate data-driven recommendations.

Candidates who enjoy solving operational problems and using data to improve business performance are encouraged to apply.

Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per year

title: Complex Revenue Analyst
description:
Compensation Type: Yearly Highgate Hotels:

Highgate is a leading real estate investment and hospitality management company with over $15 billion of assets under management and a global portfolio of more than 400 hotels spanning North America, Europe, the Caribbean, and Latin America. With a 30-year track record as an innovator in the hospitality industry, this forward-thinking company provides expert guidance through all stages of the property cycle, from planning and development through recapitalization or disposition. Highgate continues to demonstrate success in developing a diverse portfolio of bespoke lifestyle hotel brands, legacy brands, and independent hotels and resorts, featuring contemporary programming and digital acumen. The company utilizes industry-leading revenue management tools that efficiently identify and predict evolving market dynamics to drive outperformance and maximize asset value. With an executive team of seasoned hospitality leaders and corporate offices worldwide, Highgate is a trusted partner for top ownership groups and major hotel brands. www.highgate.com

Location:

Hilton Garden Inn New York Times Square Central is a brand new hotel ideally located on famous 42nd Street, steps from Broadway theaters, Restaurant Row & more. The hotel offers 282 brand-new guestrooms with king or two queen beds plus modern in-room amenities.

Overview:

The Revenue Manager is responsible for identifying and maximizing all potential revenue opportunities for the hotel. In today’s lodging environment, understanding channel and yield management is critical for maximizing revenues. The Revenue Manager is responsible for formulating long and short-term Revenue Management strategies and for overseeing their successful execution towards the advancement of RevPAR market share. This includes the analysis of revenue potential generated by the transient and group market segments as well as the market segmentation within transient and group. One will combine this with catering and space utilization as well as other revenue considerations (i.e.: golf, spa, etc.) in order to determine the appropriate mix of business to achieve revenue potentials every day of every year.

Responsibilities:

* Establish hotel pricing levels in all segments.
* Responsible for the daily room inventory management process and daily pricing process.
* Monitor competitor rates, positioning, strategies and data; maintain understanding of the dynamics of the local market and demand generators and present appropriate action plans to management.
* Monitor and communicate fluctuations in occupancy to operational departments so they can effectively manage staffing requirements and increase efficiency.
* Analyze local events and activities and project the effect of opportunities they create.
* Understand the macro and micro-economic variables affecting supply and demand in the local marketplace, and use this knowledge to create accurate operational and financial room revenue forecasts.
* Perform unconstrained demand analysis to determine optimal business mix.
* Responsible for all short and long term forecasts including Weekly Forecasts, 30 60 90 Forecasts, In the month forecasts, and Full year forecasts.
* Oversee process for evaluating all opportunities for contracted business (group, wholesale, corporate negotiated, etc.) presented through the Sales department. Ensure that process enables high speed of response while maximizing profits.
* Responsible for the maintenance of any software programs which contribute to the management of rooms revenue, including the CRS, RMS, PMS and Sales & Catering system.
* Monitor RevPAR index on STR report and provide critical analysis of performance on weekly and monthly basis.
* Prepare annual Rooms revenue budget.
* Chair weekly Revenue Strategy meetings in order to formulate and disseminate strategies and tactics. Ensure that prior decisions are re-visited in this forum in order to evaluate their effectiveness and promote learning.
* Prepare and present quarterly presentations to ownership.
* Ensure all distribution channels have correct content and pricing.
* Develop and maintain a close relationship with the market manager of Third Party Intermediaries to maximize the opportunities with these channels.
* Develop and maintain relationships with other market revenue managers and Directors of Revenue to create a network of peers in your community
* Coordinate survey activities involving marketing and service opportunities to further enhance revenue potential.
* Actively develop all subordinates, ensuring that they have opportunities to grow their Revenue Management and leadership skill base through personal attention, internal/external training and participation in industry events.
* Responsible for Internet Marketing such as pay per click campaigns, e-mail blasts, GDS advertising, etc.
* Establish and communicate sales strategy for day, week, month and rolling 12 months.
* Communicate any strategy changes or update any calendars for the sales team to use.
* Analyze prior night successes: Did the hotel sell out? Were the right decisions made for overselling? Address the opportunities in Highgate Hotel Business Review (HHBR) morning meeting.
* Place test calls to Central Reservation Office (CRO) and property to ensure accuracy of rate quoting, restrictions and selling approach.
* Manage and communicate group cut off dates. Run a group rooms control log (GRC) as well as pick up report from Property Management System (PMS) for 90 days. Verify pick up to actual block, cut off date, and whether or not you should extend, etc.
* Update the Daily Market Segment Analysis (DMSA). Ensure accuracy from the daily Flash Report. Review actual performance versus Potential performance.
* Complete all required month end reports with detailed analysis. If necessary, complete action plans for the property to follow to create additional production/revenue.
* Review Hotelligence reports for trends, booking windows and sources of business as well as rates compared to competition.

Qualifications:

* At least 2 years experience in the Revenue Management field as manager or senior analyst

title: Italian Sourcing Analyst
description:
Job Summary

Roman's is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Italian Sourcing Analyst to support supplier research, sourcing strategies, purchasing decisions, and cost analysis for ingredients, food products, and operational supplies. This role focuses on identifying reliable suppliers, evaluating product quality and pricing, analyzing market trends, and helping maintain an efficient and cost-effective sourcing process.

The ideal candidate has strong research, analytical, and communication skills, along with an interest in Italian cuisine, specialty ingredients, or food supply operations. The successful applicant will collaborate with purchasing, operations, finance, and inventory teams to assess sourcing opportunities, maintain supplier records, and support informed procurement decisions.

Key Responsibilities

* Research and identify potential suppliers of Italian food ingredients, specialty products, packaging, and operational materials.
* Analyze supplier pricing, product specifications, availability, quality standards, and delivery capabilities.
* Compare supplier proposals and prepare reports to support sourcing and purchasing decisions.
* Collect and evaluate market information related to ingredient costs, availability, and supply trends.
* Assist with developing sourcing strategies that balance cost, quality, reliability, and operational requirements.
* Maintain accurate supplier databases, product catalogs, quotations, and sourcing documentation.
* Coordinate with purchasing teams to review procurement requirements and prioritize sourcing activities.
* Monitor supplier performance, including delivery reliability, product consistency, responsiveness, and pricing.
* Support supplier negotiations by preparing cost comparisons and relevant market research.
* Identify alternative suppliers and products to help reduce supply risks and prevent shortages.
* Review ingredient specifications and coordinate quality-related questions with relevant teams.
* Track changes in market prices and communicate potential cost impacts to management.
* Help assess sourcing risks, including seasonal availability, lead times, and supplier capacity.
* Prepare spreadsheets, summaries, and presentations covering sourcing costs and supplier evaluations.
* Collaborate with inventory and operations teams to align sourcing decisions with demand and stock requirements.
* Recommend improvements to sourcing procedures, supplier selection, and procurement efficiency.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business, economics, finance, analytics, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in sourcing, procurement, purchasing analysis, market research, or supply chain operations is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and research skills.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets and standard business software.
* Ability to organize supplier information and interpret pricing data accurately.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and documentation practices.
* Ability to manage multiple research assignments and deadlines.
* Professional approach to supplier communication and cross-functional teamwork.
* Understanding of purchasing processes, supplier evaluation, and cost analysis.

Preferred Skills

* Experience sourcing food ingredients, specialty Italian products, restaurant supplies, or consumer goods.
* Familiarity with Italian ingredients, including pasta, cheeses, olive oils, tomatoes, herbs, and specialty products.
* Knowledge of supplier assessment, quotation comparisons, and procurement documentation.
* Experience with inventory systems, purchasing platforms, or enterprise resource planning software.
* Ability to use data to identify cost-saving opportunities and sourcing risks.
* Understanding of food quality specifications, traceability, and applicable sourcing requirements.
* Italian language skills may be beneficial when communicating with Italian suppliers.

Work Environment

The Italian Sourcing Analyst generally works in an office or business operations setting, collaborating with purchasing, finance, inventory, and supplier management teams. The role involves research, data analysis, documentation, and regular communication with internal stakeholders and external suppliers. Occasional supplier visits or product evaluations may be required depending on business needs.

Benefits

* Opportunities to develop analytical, sourcing, and procurement skills.
* Exposure to supplier research and supply chain decision-making.
* Collaborative and professional working environment.
* Potential career advancement into strategic sourcing, procurement management, or supply chain analysis.
* Compensation based on experience, qualifications, and employment arrangements.
* Additional benefits may be available according to company policy.

About the Company

Roman's is the company named for this employment opportunity. The Italian Sourcing Analyst will support sourcing and purchasing activities by researching suppliers, evaluating product options, analyzing costs, and maintaining accurate sourcing information. This role is suited to an analytical professional who values supplier reliability, product quality, and efficient business operations.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume highlighting relevant experience in sourcing, procurement, market research, business analysis, or supply chain operations. Applicants are encouraged to describe their analytical abilities, experience evaluating suppliers, and proficiency with data and reporting tools.

title: Managing Director (Westchester)
description:

The Managing Director (MD) is a senior operational leader responsible for driving excellence across a designated region or portfolio within AKAM’s property management division. This role oversees approximately four (4) directly managed properties while providing strategic oversight and leadership to four to five (4–5) Managing Executives and their respective portfolios.

The Managing Director is accountable for ensuring that all buildings under their supervision achieve optimal operational, financial, and service outcomes in alignment with AKAM’s mission, standards, and client expectations. This position requires a dynamic leader with strong business acumen, client relationship management skills, and the ability to coach and empower others while maintaining high accountability and engagement levels across teams.

**Reports to: Vice President, Management Operations, NE**

**Portfolio Oversight & Leadership**

* Oversee a combined portfolio that includes the Managing Director’s own assigned properties and the portfolio managed by assigned Managing Executives.
* Lead, mentor, and develop Managing Executives, Senior Managing Executives, and Assistant Managing Executives on direct managed properties, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and professional growth.
* Serve as the escalation point for high-profile, sensitive, or complex Board and resident matters, providing resolution guidance and executive-level communication.
* Conduct as needed one-on-one check-ins with Managing Executives to review portfolio performance, staffing needs, board relations, and operational priorities.

title: Encore Digital Controllership Senior Controllership
description:
**Encore Digital Controllership Senior Consultant**  
  
Help finance leaders modernize the controllership function and strengthen how finance supports the business. As an Encore Digital Controllership Senior Consultant in Deloitte's Finance Transformation practice, you will work with CFOs, controllers, and finance executives to address accounting, data, process, and technology challenges. You will help clients implement digital finance solutions that improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and support business performance.  
  
The Deloitte Encore Program is designed to enable professionals who have left the workforce to return to work with confidence. This program offers an opportunity to improve your skills in a client service environment coupled with mentorship to help support professional growth. The Encore program is an excellent opportunity to reignite your professional career.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 01/14/27.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Senior Consultant on the Controllership and Treasury Transformation team, you will be responsible for helping clients improve finance operations through process, data, and technology transformation.  

* Support client engagements focused on controllership, finance transformation, and digital finance modernization
* Gather requirements, map business processes, and support solution design, testing, and deployment
* Implement or optimize finance platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, Workiva, and BlackLine
* Develop accounting data models, reporting structures, and analytics to improve financial insight
* Contribute to proposals, practice initiatives, and day-to-day client delivery

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to align with the evolving business objectives of organizations. We collaborate with CFOs, CAOs, controllers, and treasurers to develop an efficient, high-quality, data-driven, and tech-enabled controllership and treasury function. This empowers our clients to deliver greater value to their business partners and investors.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Actuarial Science
* 3+ years of experience in accounting, controllership, financial planning and analysis, or cost accounting
* 3+ years of experience with requirements gathering, business process mapping, or full life cycle implementation for enterprise resource planning systems, finance platforms, or boundary applications
* Experience with one or more of the following: SAP, SAP Performance and Profitability Management, SAP Profitability and Cost Management, Oracle, Oracle Profitability and Cost Management, CostPerform, Workday, Workiva, BlackLine, Alteryx, Microsoft SQL Server, Tableau, or Power BI
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

  
Preferred:  

* Master's degree in Business, Information Systems, Accounting, or Finance
* Experience supervising and executing technology life cycle activities using project management and testing methodologies
* Certified Public Accountant, Certified Internal Auditor, Chartered Financial Analyst, Chartered Accountant, Certified Cost Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst, or Financial Risk Manager certification, or progress toward one of these credentials
* Knowledge of U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, International Financial Reporting Standards, Securities and Exchange Commission rules and regulations, managerial accounting, cost accounting, and profitability analysis
* Experience with reporting tools, big data tools, machine learning tools, or data visualization tools
* Experience leading a project workstream within Record to Report or Order to Cash

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,200 to $229,100.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

title: Corporate Access, Public Equities
description:
The incumbent will lead the design and execution of the Public Equities platform's corporate access strategy, ensuring portfolio managers and research analysts across public equity strategies have consistent, high-quality connectivity to public-company management teams, industry experts, and other differentiated sources of investment insight. This individual will own the platform's broker relationships, build direct issuer engagement, and construct a scalable access infrastructure, all in close partnership with the public equities investment team and in alignment with firm compliance standards.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

  

**Strategic Leadership & Chief of Staff Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as a strategic partner to Public Equities leadership, helping advance the organization’s highest-priority strategic, investment, commercial, and organizational initiatives.
* Drive coordination and execution across the Equities organization, working across investment teams and with key partner organizations including Distribution, Product, Trading, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Technology, and other enterprise functions.
* Engage with senior leadership across the firm to coordinate priorities, surface issues, accelerate decision-making, and ensure effective execution of key Equity platform initiatives.
* Lead or support cross-functional projects that span multiple investment teams or business functions, bringing structure, accountability, and momentum to initiatives that do not sit neatly within a single team.
* Act as a connector across the Equity platform, identifying opportunities to improve collaboration, share best practices, and strengthen connectivity across investment teams and adjacent functions.
* Coordinate selected external strategic relationships and initiatives where they intersect with broader Equity platform priorities.
  

**Equity Platform Development & Strategic Initiatives**

  

* Partner with Equity leadership to identify and advance opportunities to strengthen the platform across investment capabilities, operating practices, commercial effectiveness, and organizational connectivity.
* Translate strategic priorities into clear workstreams, milestones, ownership, and follow-through, helping ensure that important initiatives move from discussion to execution.
* Support senior leadership meetings, strategic planning, and platform-level communications by synthesizing information across teams, identifying key issues and decisions, and coordinating necessary follow-up.
* Develop scalable processes, tools, and operating disciplines that improve transparency, information sharing, and execution across Public Equities.
* Take on emerging priorities and special projects on behalf of Equity leadership as the needs of the organization evolve.
  

**Broker Relationship Leadership**

  

* Own and deepen strategic sell-side broker relationships on behalf of Public Equities, serving as a senior relationship lead for important equity research and access counterparties.
* Evaluate the quality and value of broker-provided research and corporate access against the needs of Public Equity investment teams, using both qualitative and quantitative measures.
* Partner with investment teams, Trading, Compliance, and other stakeholders to prioritize brokerage resources, including commissions, votes, and eligible research and access services.
* Lead periodic broker review and voting processes, ensuring resources remain aligned with the highest-value research and investment priorities of the platform.
  

**Corporate Access Strategy for Public Equities**

  

* Define and lead the corporate access strategy for the Public Equities platform, ensuring it is closely aligned with the research priorities, sector coverage, and investment processes of portfolio managers and analysts.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for the quality, breadth, and efficiency of corporate access supporting public equity strategies.

* Develop differentiated engagement opportunities, including one-on-one meetings, site visits, small-group sessions, and other direct interactions that complement traditional sell-side channels.
* Represent the Public Equities platform externally as a senior, trusted, and professional point of contact.
Leverage external relationships to enhance both investment insight and the broader connectivity and visibility of the Equity platform.

title: Sr. Analyst, Data Consulting
description:
We believe that difference sparks brilliance, so we welcome people and ideas from everywhere to join us in stretching what’s possible.
  
  
At Tapestry, being true to yourself is core to who we are. When each of us brings our individuality to our collective ambition, our creativity is unleashed. This global house of brands – Coach and Kate Spade New York – was built by unconventional entrepreneurs and unexpected solutions, so when we say we believe in dreams, we mean we believe in making them happen. We’re always on a journey to becoming our best, but you can count on this: Here, your voice is valued, your ambitions are supported, and your work is recognized.
  
  
A member of the Tapestry family, we are part of a global house of brands that has unwavering optimism and is committed to being innovative and wholly inclusive. Visit Our People page to learn more about Tapestry's commitment to equity, inclusion, and diversity.

**Job Description**

**Primary Purpose**  
The Senior Analyst, Data Analytics is a global role that applies advanced analytics, data science, and AI to fuel growth across Tapestry’s international properties. The focus is shifting from routine reporting to forward-looking, actionable insight – supporting adoption of data-based measurement across the organization, and applying automation and AI agents to accelerate decision-making and operational efficiency.

You will partner with business teams worldwide – across Merchandising, Marketing, Digital, Supply Chain, Retail, and Finance – to define the right questions, uncover high-impact opportunities, and translate analysis into practical recommendations that improve revenue, gross margin, and the customer experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support data integrity, reporting standards, tools architecture, and training – partner across functions to build data-driven analyses, models, and tools that enable self-service insight.
* Shift effort from static reporting to insight generation – build interactive dashboards, dynamic visualizations, and standardized management reporting that surface leading-indicator insights.
* Perform large-scale analyses that uncover demand and acquisition drivers, media-spend efficiency, and revenue/margin-boosting actions; translate results into clear, data-driven stories for senior business audiences.
* Support organization-wide adoption of analytics – track outcomes, document impact, and promote a data-first mindset in planning and decision-making.
* Build and maintain predictive models, automated reporting, and AI-driven recommendations (e.g., demand forecasting, allocation optimization, marketing-spend efficiency) and help embed them in core business processes.
* Develop AI agents that automate analytical workflows – performance commentary, report generation, anomaly detection, and self-service business Q&A.
* Contribute to automation & AI initiatives – execute AI/ML and agentic pilot projects, quantify tangible value, and help scale successful solutions across the global organization.
* Collaborate with data-engineering, data-science, and algorithm teams to improve data sourcing, management, and analytics product solutions.
* Connect with the Global Data Analytics (DA) team to align on reporting standards, share best practices, and support cross-regional data collaboration.
* Maintain data integrity, develop reusable analytics tools, and support stakeholder training so teams can rely on accurate, self-service data.
Track key business and operational metrics, measure efficiency, and recommend process improvements that maximize sales and gross margin, improve the consumer journey and conversion, and focus the organization on value-creating levers.  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Natural curiosity and enthusiasm for data analytics.
* 3+ years of hands-on analytics experience (retail, e-commerce, consumer, or consulting preferred).
* Solid understanding of core business metrics, unit economics, and management reporting.
* Experience applying AI/ML and agentic solutions to forecasting, personalization, or automated reporting.

description:
**Position Summary**
====================

Guggenheim Investments is looking for a Vice President, Senior Talent Partner to run full-cycle hiring for experienced professionals across the firm, from investment teams to corporate functions, and to help build the recruiting function as it grows.  
  
You will source candidates directly, assess them, sell the opportunity and close offers on your own. You'll also help shape how the firm recruits: the processes, standards, tools and reporting. You will move easily between front-office and back-office searches, earning credibility with portfolio managers as readily as with technology, operations or finance leaders.  
  
You will represent Guggenheim to senior candidates and hiring leaders in a demanding, relationship-driven industry. The way you carry yourself is part of how the market sees the firm, so judgment, discretion and polish count as much as volume. This position is based in our New York City office, full-time.

**Responsibilities**
====================

Full-Cycle Recruiting Across the Firm

* Own a varied set of experienced-hire searches across front-office roles (investment, research, portfolio management, distribution) and back-office roles (operations, technology, finance, risk, compliance and other corporate functions).
* Run each search from start to finish: scoping the role with the hiring manager, mapping the market, sourcing directly, screening, managing interviews, checking references, negotiating the offer and closing the candidate.
* Find most candidates through direct outreach, including passive candidates who aren't looking for a move. Use LinkedIn Recruiter, market maps, referrals and your own network rather than relying on applications or agencies.
* Get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar roles: learn what the role requires, who the competitors are and what the market looks like well enough to advise the hiring manager credibly within the first conversations.
* Advise hiring managers on how to define the role, what the market pays, what talent is available, and when a profile is unrealistic.
* Sell the firm and the role to candidates who are happy where they are, and handle counter offers and competing offers.
* Work with GI Hiring Council to put together offers and negotiate them firmly but fairly.

Building the Recruiting Function

* Help refine and evolve how recruiting works at the firm.
* Set the standard for candidate experience and hold the whole process to it.
* Help decide when to use outside search firms and how to manage them, and work to reduce the firm's reliance on them over time.
* Build talent pipelines for roles the firm hires often or finds hard to fill, so searches don't start from zero each time.
* Bring ideas and best practices that move the function from filling roles reactively to planning and pipelining.

Workday Recruiting & Data

* Act as the team's power user of Workday Recruiting: requisitions, candidate stages, offers, reporting and keeping data clean.
* Make sure the data in Workday is accurate enough to report on and to stand up to scrutiny.
* Build and share recruiting metrics (time to fill, how candidates move through each stage, hiring sources, offer acceptance, hiring manager satisfaction) and use them to improve how the team works.
* Help find gaps in how the system is set up or used, and work with People Technology to fix them.

Credibility & Representation

* Earn the trust of senior hiring leaders by bringing real market knowledge and a clear point of view, not just carrying out instructions.
* Represent Guggenheim to senior candidates, outside partners and industry networks with discretion and a high level of professionalism.
* Handle confidential searches, including replacements and senior hires, with the care they need.
* Keep recruiting practices consistent and well documented, working with Legal and Compliance on record-keeping and fair selection standards.

Growth & Leadership Opportunity as the function grows:

* Leading specific projects for the function, such as rolling out a process, improving how Workday is used, or reviewing outside search firms.
* Mentoring and sharing knowledge with junior recruiters and coordinators.
* Helping hire and onboard new members of the recruiting team.
* The role is a good fit for someone who wants to help shape a function, with leadership opportunities that may grow as the team develops.

* 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting, ideally including time at a search firm or on an in-house team with a strong direct-sourcing culture.

description:

Preferred locations: New York, Chicago, Washington, D.C., Dallas, and Boston. Strong candidates in other locations may be considered case by case.

  
  

**We do Consulting Differently**
--------------------------------

**About the Practice**
----------------------

Berkeley Research Group is building a new Financial Institution Operations & Technology practice, with an initial focus on Commercial and Consumer Banking. We combine deep banking expertise, technology, and AI-enabled delivery to help financial institutions turn complex business challenges into measurable operational improvements.

Our delivery model centers on small, multidisciplinary pods that work closely with clients and take shared responsibility from discovery through implementation. Business analysts, pod leaders, technical architects, and engineers work against a prioritized backlog, bringing in domain, risk, design, and quality specialists as needed. This is an opportunity to help build a practice within an established consulting firm: delivering client results while developing reusable offerings, recruiting talent, and improving how we work.

  
  

**The Role**
------------

We are considering candidates at the Managing Consultant and Senior Managing Consultant levels. You connect client objectives and operational realities with the requirements, data, and workflows engineers need to build effective solutions. You are equally comfortable leading a business workshop, mapping a process, and working through functional requirements with a technical team.

This is a senior, hands-on delivery role—not solely a strategy, documentation, or project-management position. You lead business and technology analysis for complex workstreams, stay engaged through development and testing, and help clients adopt the solution. You partner with the pod leader on priorities and outcomes and with the technical lead on feasibility and design; this role does not require you to be the pod’s primary software engineer or overall engagement lead.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Lead discovery with client stakeholders to clarify business problems, user needs, operational constraints, and opportunities for technology and AI-enabled improvement.
* Assess current-state processes, systems, and data; design future-state workflows and operating-model changes that connect business objectives to practical implementation.
* Translate findings into build-ready user stories, functional and nonfunctional requirements, business rules, process maps, and testable acceptance criteria.
* Partner with technical architects and AI/data engineers to clarify business requirements, data and integration needs, assess feasibility and trade-offs, and resolve requirements during development.
* Help the pod leader refine and sequence the backlog by business value, delivery dependencies, risk, and readiness; support sprint planning, demonstrations, and feedback-driven iteration.

* Coordinate day-to-day workstream delivery, track actions and dependencies, and surface risks and decisions to the pod leader; support backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and feedback-driven iteration.
* Prepare and review client deliverables, analysis, and stakeholder updates; help establish performance baselines and track progress against agreed business outcomes.
* Coordinate test scenarios, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, and evaluation of AI-enabled workflows, including controls and human review where appropriate.
Support implementation and adoption through business readiness, training, operating procedures, and handover; help ensure the delivered workflow remains usable after the engagement.  

  

**How You’ll Work in a Pod**
----------------------------

* Work directly with client business and technology teams and collaborate closely with pod colleagues. Own the quality and traceability of business analysis while contributing to the pod’s shared delivery outcomes.
* Use approved AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, requirements development, and delivery documentation. Validate outputs and protect client information; bring sound judgment to where AI adds value and where controls are essential.
Coach colleagues, capture reusable assets and lessons learned, and contribute to proposals, new offerings, recruiting, and thought leadership as the practice grows.

------------------

**Required**
------------

* To be considered for Managing consultant a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in business transformation, business or technology analysis, or implementation, including experience leading workstreams is required. For Sr. Managing Consultant a minimum of 7 years.
* Demonstrated experience leading business or technology analysis for complex transformation or implementation work, with hands-on responsibility from discovery and requirements through implementation.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear process models, user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria that technical teams can implement and test.
* Experience working in agile or multidisciplinary delivery teams and collaborating across business, operations, technology, risk, and compliance; ability to surface dependencies, controls, and delivery risks.
* Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills; ability to facilitate workshops, influence senior stakeholders, and take ownership of high-quality work in a fast-moving environment.
* Curiosity about AI-enabled delivery, willingness to learn and use approved tools responsibly, and ability to travel to client sites as needed.

**Preferred**

* Consulting-firm experience delivering transformation or technology-enabled change, preferably for financial institutions.
* Relevant financial services experience in consumer lending, commercial lending, or payments. Experience in mortgage, credit card, personal loan, or auto lending, including servicing, collections, and default, is valuable; adjacent banking or wealth and asset management experience is a plus.
* Experience applying AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to analysis or delivery, or helping implement AI-enabled workflows, automation, or digital solutions.
* Technical fluency in how applications, data flows, APIs, and system integrations support business processes, with the ability to discuss feasibility and trade-offs with architects and engineers.
* Experience with data analysis or SQL, process modeling, prototyping or low-code tools, and backlog-management platforms such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with regulated environments, operational controls, change management, or regulatory remediation; relevant agile, business-analysis, or AI training is a plus.
Success in this role means turning unclear business problems into actionable work, helping the pod deliver solutions that clients use, and demonstrating measurable improvement—not simply producing recommendations or presentations.
